objectives.title: Keep the chain moving
objectives.description: Deliver 50,000 m³ of the assortments mills actually accept across the season.

objectives.title: Deliver on your promises
objectives.description: Meet at least 60% of nonzero monthly assortment commitments within the agreed tolerance.

objectives.title: Protect timber value
objectives.description: Keep expired inventory below 8% of harvested volume. Downgrades still lose value even when they do not become waste.

objectives.title: A viable operation
objectives.description: Finish with nonnegative profit after acquisition, operation and terminal charges.

region.name: Lac-Saint-Jean, Québec
region.description: A twelve-week supply-chain teaching scenario around Lac-Saint-Jean. Real public-road geometry; fictional forest parcels, mill placements, access roads, capacities and prices. Inspired by the supplied FORAC teaching materials.

sources.title: FORAC Virtual Wood Supply Arena
sources.note: Teaching structure: 12 weeks, 10 crews/trucks, five assortments, monthly commitments and seasonal accessibility. Scenario coefficients are educational assumptions.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap / OSRM
sources.note: Public trunk roads from OSRM routing snapshot 2026-09-07, OSM ODbL. Car-route geometry is not certified for heavy trucks. Access spurs and parcels are simulated.

sources.title: PGMaps
sources.note: MapLibre and deck.gl map architecture; MIT attribution in PGMAPS-LICENSE.txt.
